message.guildmark.trade.report.filed: Your slip is taken and the board's row is chalked again from it. The town thinks the better of you.
message.guildmark.trade.report.off: The Word is off: there is no board to report to.
message.guildmark.trade.report.nowhere: A report is handed in at a town's board: stand in a capital.
message.guildmark.trade.report.here: You stand in that town: the board knows it as it is.
message.guildmark.trade.report.unknown: Your Tally has no sight of that town.
message.guildmark.trade.report.no_row: This board keeps no row for that town: it is too far off, or has no news yet.
message.guildmark.trade.report.stale: Your news of that town is not fresher than the board's by six hours: nobody would learn from it.
message.guildmark.trade.report.tired: You have filed three reports today. Come back tomorrow.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.booked: Booked: the tickets of that route are yours.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.gone: Word was old: that one's gone. Nothing was taken.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.refused: The town will not take that booking now. Nothing was taken.
message.guildmark.trade.tally.not_yet: Haul tickets are not open yet: there is nothing to book.
